info.name: Cisco Expressway Configuration Admin Account NTP API
Cisco Expressway List all configured NTP servers

items.docs: Retrieves the list of all NTP servers configured on the Expressway for time synchronization. Supports filtering by name or address.

info.name: Cisco Expressway Add a new NTP server

items.docs: Adds a new NTP server entry to the Expressway configuration for time synchronization. Up to five NTP servers can be configured.

info.name: Cisco Expressway Modify an NTP server entry

items.docs: Updates an existing NTP server configuration on the Expressway.

info.name: Cisco Expressway Delete an NTP server entry

items.docs: Removes an NTP server from the Expressway configuration.
